categories.main_business_segments: Longhua Technology Group operates primarily in three business segments: electronic new materials, polymer composite materials, and energy-saving environmental protection. The electronic new materials segment focuses on sputtering targets used in display panels, photovoltaics, and semiconductor industries. The polymer composite materials segment serves industries such as rail transit, aerospace, and wind power with high-performance composite materials. The energy-saving environmental protection segment includes industrial heat exchange equipment, water treatment, and extraction separation technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced sputtering target manufacturing technologies including metal, alloy, and ceramic targets with proprietary processes for high-purity molybdenum, silver alloy, and ITO targets. It employs polymer composite material technologies such as resin composites, foam materials, and structural functional integration. In energy-saving equipment, it utilizes patented high-efficiency composite cooling condenser technology and modular water treatment systems. The company also develops advanced extraction agents and separation technologies for metal recovery and recycling.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor display panel manufacturers such as BOE, TCL Huaxing, Tianma Microelectronics, Visionox, LG Display, and Innolux. The company serves industries including flat panel displays, photovoltaics, aerospace, rail transit, wind power, chemical, petrochemical, metallurgy, and environmental protection sectors. Its products are used in high-end display panels, solar cells, aerospace components, rail infrastructure, and industrial water treatment projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Longhua Technology's operations are primarily based in China with headquarters in Luoyang, Henan Province. It has subsidiaries and operations across multiple Chinese regions including Central China, North China, East China, Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, and South China. The company also has international presence through subsidiaries in Russia and Hong Kong and serves global customers in Asia and beyond.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures critical materials such as sputtering targets and composite materials used by panel makers and industrial equipment manufacturers. It also provides engineering services and products in water treatment and environmental protection, positioning itself as a key supplier and solution provider within its industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Longhua Technology emphasizes technological innovation and R&D to drive transformation towards new materials and green, low-carbon development. It invests in developing high-performance sputtering targets for next-generation displays and photovoltaics, advanced polymer composites for aerospace and rail transit, and energy-efficient industrial equipment. The company collaborates with top universities and research institutes, focusing on product upgrades, process automation, and expanding applications in emerging sectors like new energy and environmental protection.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products including sputtering targets, composite materials, and energy-saving equipment. It also earns income from engineering contracting services, water treatment projects, and related technical services. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, typically at product delivery or project milestones. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Longhua Technology is a leading domestic player in high-purity sputtering targets and polymer composite materials, successfully breaking foreign monopolies in high-end target materials. It holds a strong market position with major international panel manufacturers as clients. The company is recognized as a technology leader and standard setter in its segments, with growing market share and influence in China’s new materials and energy-saving environmental protection industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Longhua Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.71 billion, representing a 9.87% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 131 million, up 3.37%. Total assets reached RMB 6.91 billion, growing 9.21% year-over-year. The company maintains steady growth with expanding market presence and continuous investment in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary high-purity sputtering target technologies that reduce reliance on imports, advanced polymer composite materials with superior mechanical and thermal properties, and integrated energy-saving solutions. Its products meet stringent quality and performance standards demanded by leading global customers. Longhua Technology emphasizes innovation, customization, and comprehensive service capabilities to provide high-value, reliable materials and equipment that support customers’ technological advancement and sustainability goals.
